ns2:course.label: Topics in Recent European Phil
ns2:course.description: Examines the continental treatments of selected issues, such as interpersonal relationships, human nature, perception or interpretation; see Class Schedule for current topics. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PHIL 325, PHIL 411, PHIL 441, PHIL 443, or PHIL 447; or consent of instructor.
